title: Concept: Password reset token in a response
description: A password reset token returned in an API response in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A reset token is a bearer credential for the account, so returning it to the caller lets anyone who can read the response, or a cached copy of it, take over the account without the mailbox.
applicability: Deployments that render a password reset token returned in an API response into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A reset token is a bearer credential for the account, so returning it to the caller lets anyone who can read the response, or a cached copy of it, take over the account without the mailbox.
